name: post_reorder_cutlass
description: Final MoE post-reorder reduction. For each token t and hidden column h, out[t,h]=routed_scaling_factor*sum_i down_output[src2dst[t,i],h]*topk_weights[t,i]*(topk_ids[t,i]!=num_local_experts). Slots whose topk id equals num_local_experts are routed off this EP rank and contribute zero. down_output is [num_tokens*topk,hidden_size], output is a [num_tokens,hidden_size] shape/dtype template, and src2dst/topk_ids/topk_weights are [num_tokens,topk]. Returns a newly allocated tensor shaped like output; output itself is not read or mutated. Current tests exercise bfloat16 with topk 2/4/8, hidden 2048..7168 and scaling 1.0/2.5.
